decisions.reason: Floor-level shower drainage is core to the firm's move toward accessible, low-profile bathrooms, and keeping it costs little, so the option stays open even though there has been no visibility since 2019.
As the design flagship with its own page, it embodies the firm's strategic direction and justifies continued commitment.
The dedicated backflow basement drain addresses a durable safety need and was actively promoted, so its value prospects remain sound.
The air-admittance valve is a cheap complementary accessory that rounds out the system portfolio, so dropping it would release few resources despite its peripheral status.
